Supplier catalogue showing a broad part family — Dapperbuurt-Zuid

A fictional supplier catalogue repeats AMS-CORE-05 as a part-family code for several compatible assemblies. It is not a unique serial number. A matching catalogue family does not establish that two observations concern the same physical part.
